subject: Request: POC extension + free credits exception for BrightData

Subject: Quick ask — POC extension and credits

Hey Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off the 14-day POC last Tuesday but hit a content ingestion delay on our side that ate most of the evaluation window. We're still keen — product is looking strong for our use case — but we need more time. Two asks: can Redwood extend the POC by 30 days, and can you provide an additional 10K free inference credits to cover the increased token usage while we finish ingesting data?

We're running a small pilot across two internal teams and expect to move to a paid contract if latency and cost metrics hold during the extended test. I can get procurement to sign an MOU or standard PO acknowledging the extension.

Attaching: POC_scope.pdf (overview of what we need to finish).

Appreciate a quick yes/no so we can plan.

—Rachel

Team — forwarding BrightData's request. Short summary: 14-day PLG POC, ingestion delay on their end, asking for +30 days and 10k free credits. Prospect has clear intent (two teams, likely paid conversion if performance holds).

Why I think we should consider it: 
- Upside: ACV expansion potential ~ $180k ARR in 12 months if pilot converts (based on Marissa's calc below).
- Risk: credits cost approx $1.2k at current rate for 10k inference units; small compared to potential deal.

Requests: 
1) Marissa — can you confirm lift and commercial recommendation?
2) Neha — any finance/credit accounting concerns?
3) Dev — any technical caveats we should surface (e.g., sustained token costs, rate limits)?

I'll loop in leadership for approval once we have numbers.

—Jordan

Jordan / team — quick commercial note:
- BrightData is engaged; two internal buyer teams (search relevancy + enrichment) with clear success metrics (latency < 220ms p95, embedding similarity accuracy).
- Our estimates: if they convert fully, ARR ~ $180k in year 1; reasonable upsell path to $400k over 24 months.
- Recommendation: approve 10,000 free credits and 30-day extension, conditional on a one-page MOU (scope + success metrics) and procurement acknowledgement of intent to proceed if metrics met.

I recommend we set a usage cap and instrument daily usage reports shared with the customer. Sales will own the renewal conversion cadence.

I'm +1 for exception. Please include Avery for final sign-off (spend above standard PLG limits).

—Marissa

Thanks for the context. A few finance points: 
- Accounting treatment: We should record the credits as a marketing/sales promotion expense; please confirm cost bucket with ops.
- Approval threshold: anything over $1k needs either a written approval from VP Revenue or a signed MOU. Since estimated cost here ~$1.2k, route to Avery for sign-off.
- Controls: set a hard token cap (10,000) and daily alert to prevent runaway usage. Also attach procurement_PO_form.docx to get a signed acknowledgement of intent.

If we get Avery's approval, finance will log the spend and provide a one-time promo code tied to BrightData account.
